title: How do I enroll in a course?

messages.text: How do I enroll in a course?
Log in to NovaLearn (novalearn.novaedge.example), navigate to the Course Catalogue, select your course, and click Enroll. Internal self-paced courses are auto-approved.
suggestedFollowUps: How many courses can I take at the same time?
Browse Course Catalog

messages.text: Which trainings are mandatory?
All employees must complete Code of Conduct, Information Security Awareness, Data Privacy, and Workplace Health and Safety. InfoSec must be repeated every 6 months.

messages.text: Can company pay my cert?
Yes! NovaEdge reimburses up to LKR 150,000 per employee per year for approved external professional certifications. Pre-approval from your manager and HR is required.
